name: @intellectual-frontiers/ssh-server
description: The SSH server of enrollment: a device with only an ssh client and no agent enrolls inbound over ssh against our own server, which speaks a closed set of typed commands, renders the bootstrap scripts, decides by typed policy and never gives a shell.
